meta.title: Skull Types for Holo Badges
meta.description: Expanded skull types including hominin, animal, and mythical/animorph for Grok Imagine holo skull badge generation. Use with Product Showcase template for lenticular/holographic playing cards.

skull_types.description: Earliest proposed hominin, small brain, heavy brow torus, ape-like but bipedal hints.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Sahelanthropus tchadensis skull with small braincase ~360cc, thick continuous supraorbital torus, moderately projecting face, stocky build, accurate to fossil cast from Chad.
skull_types.traits: small cranium, heavy brow, reduced prognathism

skull_types.description: Small stature, prognathic face, moderate brow, bipedal with arboreal traits.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Australopithecus afarensis Lucy skull, small ~450cc brain, moderate supraorbital development, prognathic face, small cranium on robust neck, accurate to Hadar fossils.

skull_types.description: Low vault, heavy torus, modern body proportions, first major disperser.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Homo erectus Turkana Boy skull, low long cranium ~900-1000cc with heavy supraorbital torus, receding forehead, robust but reduced face, accurate to Nariokotome fossil.
skull_types.traits: low vault, heavy brow torus, robust face

skull_types.description: Long low cranium, massive double brow, occipital bun, cold-adapted robust build.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Homo neanderthalensis skull with long low vault, massive double-arched supraorbital torus, occipital bun, large midface and broad nose, robust thick bones, accurate to Amud 1 and European fossils.
skull_types.traits: long low cranium, heavy brow, bun, large nose

skull_types.description: Large brow ridge, prognathic snout, small brain relative to face, powerful jaw.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Chimpanzee skull, prominent continuous supraorbital torus, projecting face, large canines, small braincase, accurate to modern primate anatomy.
skull_types.traits: heavy brow, prognathic snout, large canines

skull_types.description: Massive sagittal crest, huge jaw, heavy brow, very robust.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Gorilla skull, massive sagittal crest for jaw muscles, enormous brow ridge, huge projecting face and jaw, small braincase, accurate to modern gorilla anatomy.
skull_types.traits: sagittal crest, massive brow, huge jaw

skull_types.description: Elongated snout, large canines, carnassial teeth, narrow cranium.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Gray wolf skull, long narrow snout, prominent canines, sharp carnassial teeth, sagittal ridge, accurate to modern wolf anatomy.
skull_types.traits: long snout, large canines, narrow cranium

skull_types.description: Human-like but with elongated upper canines, pale, slightly elongated cranium, predatory.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Vampire skull, human proportions but with dramatically elongated sharp upper canines/fangs, slightly elongated cranium, sharp incisors, pale bone with subtle gothic details, accurate to classic horror anatomy.

skull_types.description: Hybrid human-wolf: heavy brow, elongated snout, large fangs, robust jaw, wolf-like but bipedal hints.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Werewolf animorph skull, hybrid human-wolf features: heavy brow ridge, elongated snout with large canines, powerful jaw, robust bone structure, accurate to dark fantasy lupine hybrid anatomy.
skull_types.traits: lupine snout, heavy brow, large fangs, robust

skull_types.description: Very robust, heavy brow, large tusks, wide jaw, thick skull.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Orc skull, extremely robust with heavy supraorbital torus, large protruding tusks, wide powerful jaw, thick cranial bones, dark fantasy brute anatomy.
skull_types.traits: heavy brow, tusks, wide jaw, thick bone

skull_types.description: Delicate small cranium, large eye orbits, fine features, perhaps subtle wing or avian influence.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Fairy skull, delicate small cranium with oversized eye sockets, fine graceful features, subtle ethereal bone structure, whimsical fantasy anatomy with large orbits.

skull_types.description: Human face with goat horns, slightly elongated, playful but wild features.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Satyr skull, human-like cranium with prominent goat-like horns, slightly projecting face, fine but wild features, accurate to classical satyr hybrid anatomy.
skull_types.traits: goat horns, human face, wild features

skull_types.description: Human face with no horns, slightly elongated, playful but wild features, collared white linen shirt.
skull_types.prompt_addition: Satyr skull, human-like cranium with NO horns at all (fully human forehead and cranium), slightly projecting face, fine but wild features, accurate to classical satyr hybrid anatomy but humanized. Add a collared white linen shirt.
skull_types.traits: no horns, human face, wild features, white linen shirt
